detail: MISO declared EEA 2 and deployed about 2.5 GW of load modifying resources (demand response) on Jan 30. No source found reports firm load shed.

detail: ERCOT up to 20,000 MW (Feb 15-17); SPP up to 2,718 MW (Feb 15-16); MISO South 2,000 MW for transmission emergencies and up to 700 MW for an energy emergency (Feb 15-16). AECI and SPA are not named.
quote: ERCOT ultimately had to shed 20,000 MW of firm load at the worst point of the Event, with SPP and MISO operators shedding a combined total of 3,418 MW of firm load on February 15 and 16, at their worst points.

detail: Rotating outages ordered by CAISO: two 500 MW blocks for about an hour on Aug 14 and one 500 MW block for 20 minutes on Aug 15. None documented for BANC, LDWP, IID or TIDC.
quote: CAISO called two successive 500 MW blocks of controlled load shed on August 14 for a total of one hour and one 500 MW block of controlled load shed on August 15 for 20 minutes.

detail: Avista rotating outages in Spokane: unplanned on Jun 28, planned protective outages on Jun 29, to relieve strain on its own system rather than for a regional supply shortfall.
quote: Tuesday’s outages are a protective measure intended to minimize the customer impact, alleviate strain on the electric system and prevent extensive damage to the system that could result in prolonged outages.
